description: Sign an EVM transaction with the connected wallet WITHOUT broadcasting it (eth_signTransaction). Returns the signed raw transaction hex — nothing is sent on-chain. Use send_transaction to sign AND broadcast. Not all wallets support this method. Requires an active session — call connect first.

chain.description: Target chain as a CAIP-2 id ("eip155:11155111") or numeric chain id. REQUIRED — there is no default chain; pick one of the granted chains from status.

data.description: Hex-encoded calldata (e.g. "0x" for plain ETH transfer). Omit for plain transfer.

from.description: Sender address. Defaults to the connected wallet address if omitted.

value.description: Value in wei as a hex string (e.g. "0x38D7EA4C68000" for 0.001 ETH). Omit for 0.

name: sign_transaction
title: Sign transaction (no broadcast)
